name: Fantasia : At Regime's End
source:
When the Kingdom of Requia fell into the hands of its enemy, Valledyne, its crown princess fortunately managed to escape with her two trusted bodyguards. However, unbeknownst to the princess, King Armand of Valledyne has sent an assassin to end the Khalfani bloodline once and for all. The question is… will the assassin succeed?

[From [url=https://azurextwilight.itch.io/fantasia-at-regimes-end-fullversion]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当雷基亚王国落入敌人瓦莱丹之手时，其王储妃幸运地带着两名值得信赖的保镖成功逃脱。然而，公主不知道的是，瓦莱丁国王阿尔芒已经派出一名刺客来一劳永逸地终结卡法尼血统。问题是……刺客会成功吗？

[来自[url=https://azurextwilight.itch.io/fantasia-at-regimes-end-fullversion]Itch.io[/url]]
